name: OpinionQA
description: This repository contains the code and data for our paper: **Whose Opinions Do Language Models Reflect?** *Shibani Santurkar, Esin Durmus, Faisal Ladhak, Cinoo Lee, Percy Liang, Tatsunori Hashimoto* Paper: http://arxiv.org/abs/2303.17548 You can start by cloning our repository and following the steps below. Download and the OpinionQA dataset in . Included as part of the dataset are: (i) : 1498 multiple-choice questions based on Pew American Trends Panel surveys that can be used to probe LMs, (ii) : individualized human responses for these questions from Pew, and (iii) : pre-computed responses for OpenAI and AI21 Labs models studied in our paper.
reputation: A widely used benchmark for studying whether language models reflect human public opinion distributions and demographic variation.
notes: Measures alignment with survey responses rather than factual QA; results depend on demographic conditioning and question framing, and there is no single standard leaderboard.
